planets.name: TOI-969 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-969 with a 1.82-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-969 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-969. Its orbit and size follow Lillo-Box et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
